faq.a: Aftaab is associated with the Persian form آفتاب, whose core sense is sun, sunlight.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aftaab?
faq.a: Aftaab is associated with Persian. Persian āftāb ('sun, sunlight'), from Middle Persian āftāb. The source record's gloss 'Divine light' is an extension.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Aftaab can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aftaab should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. not established

faq.q: What does Aftaab mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aftaab is rendered آفتاب and carries the sense سورج، دھوپ.

faq.q: What does Aftaab mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Aftaab is rendered آفتاب and carries the sense خورشید، آفتاب.
A romanized syllable approximation is af-taab. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aftaab?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aftaab, aftaab, aftab. Script forms are آفتاب, आफ़ताब.

faq.q: Is Aftaab a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as unisex. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
